squat.label: Barbell back squat — a rounded paper character squatting inside a power rack.

bench-press.label: Barbell bench press — a paper character lying on a flat bench with a barbell above the chest.

seated-row.label: Seated cable row — a seated character pulls a cable handle toward the torso with feet braced on a footplate.

leg-curl.label: Seated leg curl — a paper character seated with a thigh restraint and lower-leg roller on a plate-loaded machine.

rdl.label: Barbell Romanian deadlift — a character hinges at the hips, holding the bar close to the lower legs.

incline-press.label: Incline barbell press — a paper character on an inclined bench holding a bar above the upper chest.

pulldown.label: Lat pulldown — a seated character pulls a wide cable bar toward the upper chest beneath an overhead pulley.

reverse-lunge.label: Reverse lunge — a rounded paper character steps one leg back and lowers the rear knee toward the floor.

arrive.label: A small paper character arrives carrying a gym bag and a folded blue towel.

pause.label: A little paper character sits on a gym bench with legs dangling, a folded towel beside it.

walk.label: A small paper character walks on a gently inclined treadmill.

finished.label: A paper character hangs a blue gym towel on a peg after training.

pages.label: A little character turns a page in an oversized folded exercise journal.
